crossRefs.note: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”
Now the centurion, and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake, and the things that were…
When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly…
The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”

translations.web: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”
translations.bsb: When the centurion saw what had happened, he gave glory to God, saying, “Surely this was a righteous man.”
translations.kjv: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
translations.asv: And when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
